title: User manual
lead: How to use {brand}: every part starts in plain words with one picture; open “In depth” for the formulas, models and sources.
simple_for: For a first look: plain words, a picture, the steps
deep_for: For experienced athletes: formulas, models, sources (folded)
search_ph: Search the manual… (e.g. send to watch, thresholds)
search_none: Nothing for “{q}”: try other words, or fewer
chart.aria: Training load chart: move the two sliders to see Chronic load, Acute load and Load balance at the end of next week
chart.offline: This chart needs the internet once to load its chart program; reload when you are online.
chart.rule_recovery: Load balance {tsb} ({pct}% of chronic load) at the end of next week, below −30%: the schedule turns the week after into a recovery week (60% of the last 4 weeks).
chart.rule_hold: Load balance {tsb} ({pct}% of chronic load) at the end of next week, below −20%: the schedule keeps the following week's volume instead of adding.
chart.rule_ok: Load balance {tsb} ({pct}% of chronic load) at the end of next week: no recovery week because of the load balance; the following week follows the season's phases.
gl.zones_aria: Heart-rate zones: drag LTHR, max HR and resting HR to see the zone edges of the lactate-threshold, heart-rate-reserve and max-HR sets
gl.rpe_aria: Training load entered by feel: pick a level and the minutes to see the load it makes
gl.grade_aria: Grade and energy cost: drag the grade and the pace to see grade-adjusted pace, VAM and effort distance
gl.power_aria: Weighted power: drag the average power and the swing to see Weighted power, Intensity and Training load
gl.power_rule: Weighted power is {d} W above the average: the bigger the swings, the higher the Intensity and Training load at the same average power.
gl.cp_aria: Power–duration curve: drag CP and Anaerobic capacity to see the power you can hold for each duration
gl.wbal_aria: Anaerobic reserve: drag the interval power and the recovery to see how much Anaerobic capacity is left
gl.wbal_empty: Anaerobic capacity runs out: at this power the last reps cannot be held. Lower the power or recover longer.
gl.wbal_deep: {p}% left at the lowest: hard but doable — a tough interval session.
gl.wbal_ok: {p}% left at the lowest: every rep comes back; there is room to go harder.
gl.drift_aria: HR drift: drag the first half's HR and the second half's rise to see the drift % and the AeT test's reading
gl.drift_under: Drift {d}% < 3.5%: your AeT can go higher — start the next test at a higher HR.
gl.drift_at: Drift {d}%, between 3.5 and 5%: the first half's HR is your AeT.
gl.drift_over: Drift {d}% > 5%: the starting HR is above your AeT — start the next test lower.
